text_block_list.text:
Keeping middle- and long-distance races in 
mind, Sakura Bakushin O secretly conducts 
research on her peers Rice Shower and 
Mihono Bourbon.

She observes the two carefully and 
discerns their traits... but when it comes 
to herself, she acts without thinking and 
lets her passion run wild.

The Trainer was at a complete loss as to 
how to guide Sakura Bakushin O.
